text:
sasha: Heads up: tablet dashboard cards feel cramped when the compact toast shows on the right. CTAs look jammed. anyone else seeing it?

rene: Yep, noticed on staging. the inline padding token at 800px is too small.

pat: Can we bump inner padding for touch breakpoints instead of outer grid gap? keeps list alignment safer.

ivy: That works. but toasts absolutely positioned to viewport still overlap CTAs.

sasha: Proposal: add .toast--anchored for confined surfaces so toasts align to card content inset instead of viewport edge. default behavior unchanged.

rene: Good compromise. Document it under components: "use anchored toasts inside cards/drawers".

pat: Accessibility nit: ensure button min-height remains >=44px when padding changes. some tertiary CTAs are 36px now.

ivy: Also check focus ring visual distance after padding changes; might feel loose. consider tightening outline inset on touch breakpoints.

sasha: I'll update tokens: card-tablet-inline -> space-12; card-compact-block -> space-6; button-min-height-touch -> 44px. Adding a note in Figma.

pat: Copy suggestion for toasts: use sentence case and contextual text, e.g., "Saved to dashboard" instead of "Saved". avoids ambiguity.

design-bot: Canary preview: visual diffs for Card and Toast generated. preview: https://redwood.design/deploys/174999

sasha: PR title: "tablet: increase card inline padding; add anchored toasts; toast copy tweaks". tagging @rene @pat for review.

rene: No objections. will review tomorrow.

ivy: I'll run keyboard nav and screen reader checks on the anchored toast variant."
